title: Allergen guidance for food businesses
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The 14 allergens; allergen information for every non-prepacked item, written or verbal with a visible written notice, written plus conversation as best practice; PPDS name and full ingredients with allergens emphasised; distance selling before purchase and at delivery; free-from and gluten-free claim controls; cross-contamination steps.

title: Allergen guidance for food businesses (publication page)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Applies to England, Northern Ireland and Wales; first published 2 Apr 2020, last updated 17 Jul 2026; allergen matrix and allergy sign downloads.

title: Safer food, better business for caterers (full pack, PDF)
supports: Opened with WebFetch and read with pdftotext. Opening and closing checks; chilled food at 8C or below (law in England, Wales, NI; recommended in Scotland), fridges at 5C or below; frozen -18C; hot holding 63C or above; cooking time and temperature pairs (60C 45 min to 80C 6 s); probe check within 1C; PPDS labelling required since October 2021.

title: Safer food, better business (SFBB)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. SFBB packs for small businesses in England and Wales (caterers, retailers, Indian and Chinese cuisine and others); Northern Ireland uses Safe Catering; daily diary kept until the next inspection; page published 5 Jun 2025.

title: Food safety management systems for businesses
supports: Opened with WebFetch. A food safety management system is a written set of processes, checks, rules and records; it must meet HACCP principles; records of checks and corrective actions are evidence in an incident. Page undated.

title: Food Hygiene Rating Scheme (FHRS): guidance for businesses
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Ratings 0 to 5 and their meanings; three inspection elements; display required in Wales and Northern Ireland, voluntary in England; 21-day appeal; right to reply; re-rating visits; updated 30 Jun 2026.

title: FDA Food Code
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The Food Code is a model adopted by local, state, tribal and federal regulators; the 2026 Food Code is the most recent full edition; page current as of 22 Oct 2026.

title: Food Allergies
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Nine major food allergens including sesame; FASTER Act signed 23 Apr 2021, effective 1 Jan 2023; FALCPA does not apply to food wrapped after ordering; page current as of 3 Nov 2026.

title: Menu Labeling Requirements
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Chains of 20 or more locations; calories on menus and boards; written nutrition information on request; two required statements; compliance date 7 May 2018; page current as of 13 Dec 2023.

title: Calorie labelling in the out of home sector
publisher: Department of Health and Social Care (GOV.UK)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Guidance on the Calorie Labelling (Out of Home Sector) (England) Regulations 2021; applies to England; in force from 6 Apr 2022; published 17 Sep 2021. Business-size threshold not on the page, so not stated in the kit.

title: Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 on the provision of food information to consumers
publisher: EUR-Lex (Publications Office of the European Union)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Article 44: allergen particulars mandatory for non-prepacked food, member states set how; Annex II list of 14; Article 21 allergen emphasis; Article 55: applies from 13 Dec 2014.

title: Create and update menus (Square for Restaurants)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Menus by upload, import, AI or by hand; menu hours and dayparts; channel visibility; leave channels unassigned to keep a draft; applies to Restaurants Free, Plus and Premium. Undated help page.

title: Mark items and modifiers as sold out
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Marking items or modifiers sold out (86-ing) hides them at checkout; optional reset time; needs item and inventory permissions. Undated help page.

title: Manage ingredient inventory with Square Restaurant Inventory
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Third-party integration by MarketMan for ingredient tracking, purchase orders and menu costing; needs Restaurants Plus or Premium (or Square Plus or Premium with advanced restaurant features). Undated help page.

title: Menu item inventory overview
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Menu item inventory is not ingredient inventory; statuses In Stock, Out of Stock (86ing) and Quantity, which counts down as items are sent to the kitchen; changes take effect when published.

title: Publishing overview
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Saved changes are not visible on devices until published; publish to each location; no rollback feature, so revert by changing back and publishing again.

title: Create and edit your menu (Business Profile menu editor)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Menu editor for food and drink businesses; sections, items, descriptions and prices; experimental AI menu from a photo; changes can take 24 to 48 hours; Google may transcribe menus from the website; API for multiple profiles.

title: Read and reply to reviews
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Only verified businesses can reply; replies checked against policies, usually within 10 minutes, sometimes up to 30 days; reviewer is notified; replies can be edited or deleted; reviews can be flagged.

title: Get bookings through Reserve with Google
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Bookings through a provider; provider may charge for bookings through Google; providers appear within a week; waitlists for restaurants only through an eligible provider.

title: Consumer Reviews and Testimonials Rule: Questions and Answers
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Rule effective 21 Oct 2024; incentives allowed if not conditioned on sentiment; steakhouse coupon example of a breach; insider disclosure; review suppression banned; page dated November 2024.

title: Short guide for businesses publishing consumer reviews and complying with consumer protection law
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Bans fake reviews, concealed incentivised reviews and misleading review information; publishers need a policy, risk assessment and detection processes; published 4 Apr 2025.

title: Set up team schedules
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Availability, shifts, open shifts, publish with notify affected or all team members; Square Shifts Free covers up to 5 team members. Undated help page.

title: Rest breaks at work
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Adults working over 6 hours get one 20-minute break; 11 hours' daily rest; 24 hours a week or 48 hours a fortnight weekly rest.

title: Working Time Directive
publisher: European Commission (Employment, Social Affairs and Inclusion)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Directive 2003/88/EC: 48-hour average week, break when the day is over 6 hours, 11 hours' daily rest, 24 hours' weekly rest, 4 weeks' paid leave, night work limits.

title: Fact Sheet #15: Tipped Employees Under the Fair Labor Standards Act
publisher: US Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Tipped employee over $30 a month in tips; $2.13 cash wage; maximum tip credit $5.12; managers may not keep employees' tips; tip pool rules; states may be more protective.

title: Predictive scheduling
publisher: Oregon Bureau of Labor and Industries
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Retail, hospitality and food service employers with 500 or more employees worldwide; 14 days' written notice; pay for late changes; 10-hour rest between shifts unless the worker agrees. Undated page; used as one US example.

title: Distributing tips fairly: statutory code of practice
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Employment (Allocation of Tips) Act 2023 in force 1 Oct 2024; all tips passed on without deductions; code published 29 Jul 2024; England, Scotland and Wales.

title: Wasted Food Scale
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Ranking of wasted food pathways from prevention (most preferred) through donation and upcycling to landfill, incineration and the drain (least); page updated 16 Sep 2026.

title: Publication 334 (2025), Tax Guide for Small Business
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Cost of goods sold: beginning inventory plus purchases and other costs gives goods available, minus ending inventory gives cost of goods sold (Schedule C lines 35 to 42). Used for the arithmetic only, not tax advice.

title: Food Service Managers (Occupational Outlook Handbook)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Median pay $69,390 (May 2025); 6% projected growth 2025-35; about 344,300 jobs in 2025; duties include hiring, scheduling, ordering, overseeing preparation, compliance, budgets and complaints; page modified 29 Oct 2026.
